description: This file implements functions for constructing, parsing, and validating Netlink attributes, including handling nested attributes and various data types, as part of a Netlink communication library.

methods.name: nla_ok
methods.description: Checks if a netlink attribute header and payload can be safely accessed within the remaining stream size.

methods.name: nla_next
methods.description: Returns the next attribute in a stream based on the current attribute's length, updating the remaining byte count.

methods.name: validate_nla
methods.description: Validates a netlink attribute against a specified policy, checking type, length, and data consistency.

methods.name: nla_parse
methods.description: Parses a stream of attributes into an array indexed by attribute type, optionally validating each attribute.

methods.name: nla_validate
methods.description: Validates all attributes in a stream against a specified policy.

methods.name: nla_find
methods.description: Finds and returns the first attribute of a specified type within a stream.

methods.name: nla_reserve
methods.description: Reserves space for an attribute in a netlink message, initializing its header.

methods.name: nla_put
methods.description: Adds a new attribute with specified data to a netlink message.
